## Rebuild the TRIE_DIFF digest correctly: entries are reviewer-first — a human… — 2026-07-25 (parent 54c25172a21b)

Fixes the `--write` path of `diff_cmd` to import from `trie.session_log` (dropping the nonexistent `trie.digest_cursor` import) and to derive the digest entry title from `session_note` rather than per-symbol patch notes. Also tightens `_one_line` to prefer a word boundary when hard-truncating. The `diff_cmd` description is updated to reflect that `--write` and `--json` are mutually exclusive and that `--model` only affects narrative synthesis. Test descriptions for `test_build_narrative_prompt_sections_and_truncation` and `test_collect_session_diff_gathers_all_evidence` are condensed to match the corrected behaviour.
